0.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_010
0.description: Ready to join the flock of fans, are we? Or perhaps, there is something you wish to know before attending the show?

5.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_020
5.description: In order to participate in the FATE “Live from Ul'dah,” you must be a Disciple of War or Magic.

6.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_021
6.description: Very well, I will ready your garments at once. Have you decided which color you wish to wear?

7.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_Q2_000_000
7.description: Select the color of your ensemble.

14.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_CONFIRM_000_001
14.description: A fan of Narumi I see. Then I shall prepare your yellow ensemble?

15.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_CONFIRM_000_002
15.description: A fan of Ulala I see. Then I shall prepare your red ensemble?

16.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_CONFIRM_000_003
16.description: A fan of Masha Mhakaracca I see. Then I shall prepare your blue ensemble?

17.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_CONFIRM_000_004
17.description: A fan of Picot I see. Then I shall prepare your violet ensemble?

18.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_CONFIRM_100_004
18.description: You will be assigned an ensemble at random. Proceed?

19.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_022
19.description: Here are your clothes and illuminations. I do hope you enjoy the performance.

20.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_100_022
20.description: Please note that you will be unable to proceed with certain quests while the “Face in the Crowd” status is active.

21.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_023
21.description: The status effect granted to you by the royal handmaiden can be removed at any time by using the special action Curtain Call.

22.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_024
22.description: Should you accidentally remove this effect, speak with the royal handmaiden once more to rejoin the fans.

24.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_A3_000_001
24.description: How can I show my support?

26.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_A3_000_003
26.description: What can you tell me about the show?

28.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_030
28.description: When the Songbirds and Seneschal Prince are ready to take the stage, speak with me and I will ready your garments.

29.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_031
29.description: And be certain to keep your illuminations at the ready. Our performers are always overjoyed to see fans cheer for them using their signature colors.

30.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_032
30.description: With your help, this will be a performance none shall soon forget.

31.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_033
31.description: In order to participate in the FATE “Live from Ul'dah,” you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and prepare yourself to join the Songbirds' crowd of fans.

32.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_034
32.description: Upon joining the FATE, you will be given four special actions. Each action uses a different colored set of illuminated rods to cheer for the Songbirds and the Seneschal Prince.

33.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_035
33.description: Bear in mind each performer is especially receptive to fans who cheer using their signature color.

34.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_040
34.description: As way of thanks to those who come to join in our merrymaking, we are handing out certificates of collaboration.

35.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_041
35.description: Speak with the royal servant and you can exchange them for a number of wondrous goods. If you lack the requisite number of certificates, I would encourage you to attend another performance to receive more.

36.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_042
36.description: Certificates of collaboration can be obtained by participating in the FATE “Live from Ul'dah” on Emerald Avenue.

37.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_050
37.description: The Songbirds and Seneschal Prince will be performing several times throughout the day adhering to a strict schedule, so be certain not to be late.

38.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_051
38.description: Your celebratory garments and illuminations are presently in our keeping, but when you have need of them, come and speak with me. I will be more than happy to retrieve them for you.

39.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_052
39.description: As you have four sets of garments to choose from, however, I will need to know which you wish to wear to the performance.

40.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_HANDMAID00476_000_053
40.description: And be certain to keep your illuminations at the ready. Our performers are always overjoyed to see fans cheer for them using their signature colors.

41.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_054
41.description: During this event, the FATE “Live from Ul'dah” will appear on the Steps of Nald.

42.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_055
42.description: In order to participate in the FATE, you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and prepare yourself to join the crowd of fans.

43.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_056
43.description: Upon joining the FATE, you will be given four special actions. Each action uses a different colored set of illuminated rods to cheer for the Songbirds or the Seneschal Prince. Bear in mind each performer is especially receptive to fans who cheer using their signature color.

44.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_057
44.description: The status effect granted to you by the royal handmaiden can be removed at any time by leaving the area, or using the special action Curtain Call.

45.name: TEXT_FESPDY2026FATEDISGUISE_00951_SYSTEM_000_058
45.description: Should you accidentally remove this effect, speak with the royal handmaiden once more to rejoin the fans.
